author: Literature Devil
description:
Han Solo died for nothing in Star Wars: The Force Awakens.

Han Solo went to Starkiller Base to help rescue Rey, but Rey had already escaped on her own, beaten her guards, and was ready to steal a ship. By the time Han and Finn arrived, Rey didn’t really need rescuing — which makes Han’s death at the hands of Kylo Ren feel tragically unnecessary.

Was Han Solo’s death a powerful emotional moment, or did The Force Awakens kill him off just because the plot needed him gone?

This Star Wars Short breaks down why Han Solo may have died for nothing in the sequel trilogy.

#HanSolo #StarWars #TheForceAwakens #KyloRen #StarWarsShorts
title: Han Solo Died for Nothing
